$comment: The instruction line of K-065 Left and Right, K-066 Top, Middle, Bottom and K-067 Inside and Outside for each place a copy can ask (types/_shared/position-words.js). The FIRST place of a mode is the one the published pages ask; its sentence is the type's registered instruction (i18n/strings.<loc>.json), word for word: the factory refuses to load when they differ. Native per language (2026-11-17).
